image.text:
• For Search and Rescue purposes

  • Filed using shoreline to shoreline

  • Should NOT be filed in the air

  • Pilot must be familiar with Lake Reporting Service procedures prior to activation.

  • Pilot must be clear as to which flight plan they are closing when they reach the opposite shoreline

  • Pilot may file a separate VFR flight plan from their actual departure point to their actual destination
